content.page_title: Reference list (heart failure, diuretic strategies, serum chloride, hypochloraemia)
content.page_summary: A list of references (entries 786–794) focusing on management of acute and chronic heart failure, including studies of high-dose furosemide with hypertonic saline, real-world use of hypertonic saline, serum chloride and hypochloraemia associations with prognosis and readmission, diuretic resistance, and use of acetazolamide to increase natriuresis.
